summary: Regression-focused retest of the evidence-matching background-job fix. Updated /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py to treat /match as async (added _poll_match helper + 3 new regression tests: fast-return with status=running, match-status 404 for unknown opp, match-status 404 cross-user) and reran the full suite: 31/31 PASS. Frontend E2E golden path as admin completed end to end: login -> Career Profile shows seeded VERIFIED James nodes (USAA, CPS Energy) -> created Allstate Director of Product Management opportunity (15 tiered requirements) -> Run Evidence Matching switched to Evidence tab, showed the 'Retrieving verified evidence & scoring matches...' loading state while the background job ran, and rendered the populated Evidence Map in 19.1s with NO hang and NO 'origin webserver returns invalid' gateway error (TOTAL 15 / COVERED 9 / GAPS 6, 22 match-strength indicators, 6 gap callouts incl. Bachelor-degree-style requirements) -> Generate Resume produced representation with 12 per-claim CKN trace badges -> Run Validation returned 'Resume Contract: PASSED' with all 10 gates PASS. The previously reported false all-gap pre-match state is fixed (map is only set when matched:true; unmatched state now shows a neutral prompt).

minor.issue: Job is launched with a bare asyncio.create_task and no task reference is retained; if the backend worker restarts mid-job the opportunity is left permanently in matching_status='running' with no timeout/stale-job recovery, and the frontend poller would spin for 6 minutes then report 'Matching timed out'. Consider a started_at timestamp + staleness check.

No guard against re-entrancy: clicking/POSTing twice while status=='running' starts a second concurrent job (the first job's inserts are not cancelled), which can duplicate or interleave evidence_matches writes.

Per-requirement AI failures are swallowed to suggestions=[] and the job still reports 'complete'; a partial/all-failed AI run is indistinguishable from a genuine all-gap result. Consider recording per-requirement failure count in the status payload.
STILL OPEN from iteration_1: no rate limiting / brute-force lockout (6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401).
STILL OPEN: allow_origins=os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS','*') with allow_credentials=True is an invalid/unsafe combo; require explicit origins with no wildcard fallback.
STILL OPEN: no ObjectId validation (500 on malformed id) and no 404 for unknown-but-valid id.

ui_bugs.issue: Polling only exists inside the runMatch click handler. If the user reloads or navigates away while a matching job is running, loadAll never calls GET /match-status, so the Evidence tab shows the neutral 'Run Evidence Matching to build the map' prompt with no indication a job is in flight; clicking again starts a duplicate job. Fix: check match-status on mount and resume polling when status==='running'.
First status poll is delayed by 3s after the POST (sleep-then-poll), so a fast/cached job still shows the spinner for a minimum of 3s. Minor; poll immediately then back off.
STILL OPEN from iteration_1 (not retested this round): modal cannot be dismissed via Escape/backdrop and the overlay intercepts sidebar nav clicks.

integration_issues.issue: STILL OPEN: representation and validation are fetched unconditionally on mount, logging 4x 404 'Failed to load resource' console errors before generation/validation exist. Harmless but noisy.

issues: Provenance rationale text (text-slate-500 italic on #0B0F17) is ~3:1 contrast — below WCAG AA for body text; same for the 'TOTAL 15' meta labels.
Success toast (top-right) still overlaps the 'Back' link, briefly making it unclickable.

action_items: PRIMARY REGRESSION VERIFIED FIXED — no action needed: /match returns <1s with status=running, match-status goes running->complete in ~19s, evidence-map then returns matched:true with populated rows; no gateway timeout in API or UI.
Resume polling on mount when match-status==='running' (currently a page reload loses the job's UI state) and block a second /match while one is running.
Surface per-requirement AI failure counts so a failed AI run is not reported as a legitimate all-gap result.

Carry-over from iteration_1: admin invite modal Escape/backdrop close; ObjectId validation + 404 on /admin/pilots/{id}/enable|disable; login throttling; remove '*' CORS fallback with allow_credentials=True.
critical_code_review_comments: Background-job design is correct for the gateway-timeout fix: status is persisted on the opportunity document (survives the request), stale matches are deleted before the job starts, and asyncio.Semaphore(5) bounds AI concurrency. Matching semantics are unchanged — verified-only retrieval, match_strength in [0,1] sorted desc, top match always 'primary', weights within {primary,supporting,contextual,chronology} (all asserted and passing).
asyncio.create_task's return value is discarded — Python can garbage-collect a task with no strong reference; keep a module-level set of running tasks with a done-callback to be safe.
evidence_map's new 'matched' flag cleanly resolves the iteration_1 false-all-gap bug; frontend correctly gates on m.data.matched.
server.py is now 651 lines — still under but close to the 700-line split threshold; split auth/career/opportunity/admin routers.
@app.on_event('startup') remains deprecated — migrate to the lifespan context manager.
seed_data_creation: pytest created TEST_*@example.com users/nodes/opportunities; frontend E2E created one admin-owned Allstate opportunity (6a9a110aef1df4e6d5711b7a) with matches, representation and validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has _poll_match(client, opp_id) — ALWAYS poll GET /opportunities/{id}/match-status until 'complete' before asserting evidence-map/generate/validate; POST /match only returns {status:running}. Suite is 31 tests, runs under pytest.ini's -n 2 --dist loadscope in ~55s. Frontend runMatch polls every 3s; matching takes 15-25s for 15 requirements so use a 180s wait_for_selector on [data-testid="evidence-map-table"]. Untested this round: resume upload/ingestion flow and Admin page UI (carry-over iteration_1 issues).
rca_of_the_issue: Original UAT failure: POST /match made one AI call per requirement serially inside the HTTP request (~15 calls), exceeding the ingress gateway timeout -> 'origin webserver returns invalid'. Fix moves the work into an asyncio background task with Semaphore(5) concurrency and persists matching_status on the opportunity, so the HTTP request returns in ~0.02-1s and the client polls /match-status. Verified by measurement: POST returned in <10s asserted (actual sub-second), status transitioned running->complete, evidence-map matched:true with 15 rows / 9 covered / 6 gaps; UI rendered the map after 19.1s with no error.
